create_isomap_embedding: create an Isomap manifold learning embedding to reduce data dimensionality using geodesic distances
fit_isomap_model: fit an Isomap model on training data to compute the geodesic distance matrix and embedding vectors
fit_transform_data: fit an Isomap model and transform data into a lower-dimensional manifold space
transform_new_data: transform new data points into the learned Isomap embedding space using nearest neighbor distances
compute_reconstruction_error: compute the Isomap reconstruction error measuring fidelity between original and embedded distances
